failure.title: Docker smoke expected private approval evidence in the public programme contract
failure.note: The cold no-cache protocol passed QA-DKR-001 through QA-DKR-007, then retained QA-DKR-008 and its exact failure message after the smoke flow rejected a contract-valid blocked override response. The older report did not retain a top-level failure object or stack.
failure.diagnosis: The public programme schema does not expose approvalKind, but the smoke harness asserted that private database audit field on the API response. The product had persisted override approval and coach-action evidence correctly; the verifier queried the wrong boundary.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
